RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

Panel composition alone proves nothing. Public broadcasters often have female-majority newsrooms and HR functions, so an all-women panel can arise by chance or demographics. Leading with it signals grievance rather than substance, and tends to discredit otherwise reasonable complaints.

The stated rationale is plausible: "strong experience of digital media" is exactly what broadcasters are hiring for, and it can outweigh seven extra years of conventional news experience. Fewer years doesn't mean weaker candidate.

Your genuine issue is procedural: a two-week-old request for written reasons, unanswered. Chase that in writing, citing your right to feedback. If the reasons given are inconsistent, vague, or shift over time, you'll have something concrete — and only then reassess.
